why_use_section.title: Why We Engineer with MySQL
why_use_section.subtitle: MySQL remains the gold standard for relational data, offering unmatched reliability for structured workloads.
paragraphs: For applications requiring strict data integrity and complex relational queries, MySQL is our primary choice. Its robust support for ACID transactions ensures that every operation is processed reliably, making it ideal for financial systems and core business logic.

By utilizing modern storage engines like InnoDB and implementing advanced indexing strategies, we provide a data layer that balances high-speed read performance with the safety of structured data management.
